statement: ∀ X r : ℕ, 1<r → ((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter fun p => p.Prime ∧ r^2 ∣ p+2).card ≤ X/r^2+1

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 重复最小素因子的整除上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Count the repeated least-factor divisibility loss

brief.zh: 对 $2z_0\le r<z_*$，只计最小素因子为 $r$ 且 $r^2\mid p+2$ 的项。逐 $r$ 的整除计数至多 $2X/r^2+1$，故这些项的总权 $\ll(X/z_0+\sqrt X)\log^2(2+X)$。
brief.en: For fixed r bound the number of candidates by the number of multiples of r² in the containing interval.
